budget_items.topic: Lanni Orchards APR purchase - Town contribution
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town was asked to contribute 10% of the appraised property value, which the minutes put at $58,000; any Town contribution needs Special Town Meeting approval.
budget_items.quote: the town has been asked to contribute 10% of the property value ($580,000) or $58,000.

budget_items.topic: Power purchase agreement - Borrego Solar proposal savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Savings to the Town from the proposed Borrego Solar 650 kw project were estimated at around $56,000 per year for 20 years.
budget_items.quote: savings for the town would be around $56,000 per year for 20 years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: BRR#10 in the amount of $31,540 covers ADA compliance for humidity sensor mountings; the Board authorized the Chair to sign the BRRs as presented.
budget_items.quote: brr#10 is in the amount of $31,540 that covers some ada compliance

budget_items.what_was_recorded: BRR#11 in the amount of $16,999 covers added electrical service, electronic door hardware revisions, and walk-in freezer alarm electrical and sensor work.
budget_items.quote: brr#11 is in the amount of $16,999, for adding electrical service

budget_items.what_was_recorded: BRR #12 in the amount of $7,127 covers electrical/data wireless for the outdoor classroom; the majority of the work was donated by the power company.
budget_items.quote: brr #12 is in the amount of $7,127 for providing electrical/data wireless for the outdoor classroom.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: BRR #13 totals $768,768 across site digital sign, new maintenance garage, added classroom-wing cooling, and stadium wheelchair lift enclosure.
budget_items.quote: brr #13 in the total amount of $768,768, is in various amounts; $56,415 for the added site digital sign,

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No further change orders known; $3,168,612 remains in the construction contingency.
budget_items.quote: leaving $3,168,612 remaining in the construction contigency

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two accounts payable warrants and one payroll warrant were signed.
budget_items.quote: an accounts payable warrant of $787,364.50, another accounts payable warrant of $450,833.58 and a payroll warrant of $770,431.27 were signed.
